purpose: Consumer buying guides through transparent comparison, real terms, total ownership cost, durability, repair, and remedies.

Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name product, model, seller, market, jurisdiction, and date. Disclose affiliate incentives, compare complete costs, and verify current safety and consumer-rights rules.
